name: Frost ward
look: Frost ward, an ice barrier from cultivation fantasy. A faceted shell of pale blue ice crystals encloses the character in a tall dome, sharp facets catching cold light, frost mist at its foot.
subject: shield

parts.name: MAIN
parts.text: the faceted ice dome alone, every facet in place, no mist and no glow

parts.name: SHARD
parts.text: one ice crystal shard alone, upright, its facets and highlight clear
forms: a small crystal just growing from the ground

parts.name: MIST
parts.text: the frost mist that lies at the dome's foot, alone

parts.name: FX
parts.text: the small effects alone, spread out so none overlap: ice sparkles, small ice chips, a frost crack

parts.name: LIGHT
parts.text: only the glow of the ice, the light it gives off, with no solid shape drawn

layers.name: SOLID
layers.text: the solid shapes, opaque, with no glow, no sparks and no specks

layers.name: FX
layers.text: the small effects: sparks, specks, chips, flecks and puffs, with no solid shape and no glow

layers.name: LIGHT
layers.text: the glow: the soft light round the shapes and the effects, with no solid shape drawn

rows.name: INIT
rows.caption: shield forms
rows.text: ice crystals grow up from the ground and close over the character into the shell
notes: only a few faint specks of light, under 20 pixels: the shape is not visible yet
the whole effect fully formed, exactly as MAIN on the parts sheet, as big as in every other moment

rows.name: IDLE
rows.caption: shield holds
rows.text: the shell holds; cold light glints across the facets and a little frost mist drifts at its foot; it loops

rows.name: HIT
rows.caption: blow lands from the right
rows.text: a blow strikes the shell's right side; white cracks spread from the impact point across the facets, ice chips fly off to the right

rows.name: BREAK
rows.caption: shield ends
rows.text: the cracked shell shatters into ice shards that fall and scatter on the ground
notes: a few last faint specks, under 20 pixels
